library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Build the appender via OpenTelemetryAppender.builder().setOpenTelemetry(...).build() (or OpenTelemetryAppender.install(openTelemetry)) and call append(LogEvent) directly against an in-memory SdkLoggerProvider/LogRecordExporter, the same way the opentelemetry-logback-appender-1.0 test exercises LoggingEventMapper — no log4j2.xml/properties config file or system properties are needed to drive the appender itself. If exercising builder options (setCaptureExperimentalAttributes, setCaptureCodeAttributes, setCaptureMapMessageAttributes, setCaptureMarkerAttribute, setCaptureContextDataAttributes, setNumLogsCapturedBeforeOtelInstall), set them directly on the builder rather than via system properties.
risks: log4j-core version (2.25.1) is pinned to match the sibling test rather than independently verified against this module's own compatibility range; confirm via the normal test/checkMetadataFiles run.
No Docker image is needed since the module only bridges to the in-process OTel Logs Bridge API (no OTLP/collector export path is exercised here).
